summary: Practise statement analysis, budgeting, cash-flow review and Excel forecasting. Explore this five-day foundation course and strengthen your finance work.
lede: Financial analysis and forecasting helps finance staff, budget holders and business analysts interpret statements and operating figures to prepare practical plans. You’ll practise ratio and margin analysis, assess cash flow and working capital, and build Excel budgets and driver-based forecasts with documented assumptions. The foundation course also covers basic investment appraisal and concise commentary to explain results to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or use budgets and financial reports and want a practical foundation in interpreting figures, testing assumptions and explaining financial implications.
prerequisites: Basic arithmetic and familiarity with business income and expenses will help you complete the exercises. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed and access to an existing Excel licence.
